You: Sure…
After the first question I was almost sure that she was a bot, but now…
The way she blew me off…{{wi}} She did it masterfully.
Maybe someone taught her that?
Her owner had to somehow ensure that his bot would not be discovered, that’s probably what happened.
Anyway, talking to her any more would only raise her suspicions so let’s go back for now.
Oh, I almost forgot. The groceries.
